reasoning: Assign score x by the parity of the number of set bits of x-1, with even parity assigned X so score1 belongs to X. The signed generating polynomial is the product over j=0..n-1 of(1-z^(2^j)), which has a zero of order n at z=1. Its first n power moments therefore vanish, including after shifting scores by1, proving equality for every polynomial of degree below n. Integer bit counts handle n up to60 without generating2^n scores.
